install.windows_download: Open the official latest installer in the default browser: x64 https://claude.ai/api/desktop/win32/x64/setup/latest/redirect, arm64 https://claude.ai/api/desktop/win32/arm64/setup/latest/redirect. The browser saves it under Downloads.
install.macos_download: Open the official latest universal DMG in the default browser: `open "https://claude.ai/api/desktop/darwin/universal/dmg/latest/redirect"`. The browser saves it under ~/Downloads.
install.linux: Linux beta supports Ubuntu 22.04+ / Debian 12+, x86_64 or arm64. Follow https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-linux to register Anthropic’s signed apt repository, then run `sudo apt update` and `sudo apt install claude-desktop`. Fedora/Arch are not officially supported by Desktop.
install.note: Use the official download links or package-manager manifest. WinGet still downloads from Anthropic’s CDN; it does not guarantee access on a blocked network. Linux launches with `claude-desktop` and updates through apt. A GUI session is required. The claude.ai download links answer browsers only and return 403 to curl or wget, so open them in the default browser. Older claude.ai/downloads links are outdated.

install_flow.summary: Detect OS and architecture → install the official package → verify the desktop app launches.
agent_steps: Check OS and architecture. Linux requires Ubuntu 22.04+ or Debian 12+ on x86_64/arm64 and a desktop session.

Windows: use winget Anthropic.Claude when available; otherwise open the official latest installer in the default browser (https://claude.ai/api/desktop/win32/x64/setup/latest/redirect for x64, https://claude.ai/api/desktop/win32/arm64/setup/latest/redirect for arm64). macOS: run `open "https://claude.ai/api/desktop/darwin/universal/dmg/latest/redirect"` to download the latest universal DMG in the default browser. Do not fetch these links with curl or wget (claude.ai answers them with 403), and do not use older claude.ai/downloads links.

Linux: read https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-linux for the signed apt repository commands and key fingerprint; verify the signing key, add the repository, then install claude-desktop. The docs also provide a direct .deb fallback. Let the user run sudo commands if elevation is unavailable.
For browser downloads, wait for the installer to appear in Downloads, report its full path and open it for the user to finish. For package-manager installs, inspect the exit result.
Verify Claude appears in the application menu and opens. First sign-in remains in Claude. On Linux, verify the installed package and `claude-desktop` launcher.
If an official download is unreachable, diagnose that host and use the user’s configured proxy; do not assume WinGet bypasses the blocked host.
tell_user: Install method and version when available
Whether installation and the first launch completed
